import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Set up the figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Credit Card Fraud Detection Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# Color palette for fraud status
colors = {0: '#2ecc71', 1: '#e74c3c'}
fraud_labels = {0: 'Legitimate', 1: 'Fraud'}

# Plot 1: Transaction Amount Distribution by Fraud Status
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
for fraud_status in [0, 1]:
    subset = df[df['is_fraud'] == fraud_status]
    ax1.hist(subset['amount'], bins=30, alpha=0.6, 
             label=fraud_labels[fraud_status], color=colors[fraud_status])
ax1.set_xlabel('Transaction Amount ($)', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Transaction Amount Distribution by Fraud Status', fontsize=11)
ax1.legend()
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# Plot 2: Fraud Count by Transaction Type
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
fraud_by_type = df.groupby(['transaction_type', 'is_fraud']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
x = range(len(fraud_by_type.index))
width = 0.35
bars1 = ax2.bar([i - width/2 for i in x], fraud_by_type[0], width, 
                label='Legitimate', color=colors[0])
bars2 = ax2.bar([i + width/2 for i in x], fraud_by_type[1], width, 
                label='Fraud', color=colors[1])
ax2.set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Transaction Count by Type and Fraud Status', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_xticks(x)
ax2.set_xticklabels(fraud_by_type.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
ax2.legend()
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# Plot 3: Fraud Rate by Hour of Day
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
hourly_stats = df.groupby('hour_of_day').agg({
    'is_fraud': ['sum', 'count']
}).reset_index()
hourly_stats.columns = ['hour', 'fraud_count', 'total_count']
hourly_stats['fraud_rate'] = hourly_stats['fraud_count'] / hourly_stats['total_count'] * 100

ax3.bar(hourly_stats['hour'], hourly_stats['fraud_rate'], color='#3498db', alpha=0.7)
ax3.axhline(y=df['is_fraud'].mean() * 100, color='red', linestyle='--', 
            label=f'Overall Fraud Rate ({df["is_fraud"].mean()*100:.1f}%)')
ax3.set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Fraud Rate (%)', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_title('Fraud Rate by Hour of Day', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_xticks(range(0, 24, 2))
ax3.legend()
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# Plot 4: Box Plot of Amount by Transaction Type and Fraud Status
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
df['fraud_label'] = df['is_fraud'].map(fraud_labels)
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='transaction_type', y='amount', hue='fraud_label',
            palette=[colors[0], colors[1]], ax=ax4)
ax4.set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Transaction Amount ($)', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_title('Transaction Amount by Type and Fraud Status', fontsize=11)
ax4.legend(title='Status')
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
